subject: Request to surgically remove single conversation from telemetry logs - ZEPHYR-590

From: Laura Myers <laura.myers@meditrust.com>

Cc: Meditrust Compliance <compliance@meditrust.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: One-off deletion request — conversation id ZP-77a (data residency)

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for taking the call last week. We've run into a retention edge case: a single support conversation (internal–external thread id ZP-77a) contains PII that must be removed from your telemetry/audit logs to comply with a customer data residency policy. Our security team is requesting Redwood to delete only that conversation from any telemetry/audit indices and confirm the action.

Can you confirm the exact steps you need from Meditrust (signed form, PoA, ticket number) and an estimated timeline? We only need the single-thread excision, not a wider purge.

Attaching a CSV export showing the log rows we believe correspond (audit_log_excerpt.csv).

—Laura
Laura Myers
Head of Information Security, Meditrust
laura.myers@meditrust.com

Subject: Re: One-off deletion request — conversation id ZP-77a (data residency)

Laura —

Appreciate the export and context. We can perform a targeted excision of a single conversation from our telemetry and audit indices, but we need: 1) a signed authorization from Meditrust approving the specific thread id (ZP-77a) for removal, and 2) confirmation that the requestor is an owner for the Meditrust tenant.

I'll loop in Marissa from Support and Neha from Sales to help coordinate the authorization and to scope the potential impacts on billing/audit. Goal: provide an estimated ETA after we receive the signed form.

Team —

Action plan from Support side:
- We'll validate the CSV rows and map them to our audit index (expected 12 rows).
- After legal sign-off (Rishi), we will schedule a maintenance window to run an indexed deletion job that targets only the conversation id ZP-77a. The job will write an immutable deletion audit entry and a post-action report.
- Estimated runtime: 2–4 hours (including verification). We will not remove associated billing records; only telemetry/audit indices and non-prod analytics copies where present.

Rishi — can you confirm the wording for the authorization we need on Meditrust's signed form (POA / DSAR waiver language)?

Marissa Cole
